name: worktrees
description: Gives every agent that can edit a git worktree of its own, runs a project's setup script with its own port range, kills what an agent left running, removes an agent's worktree and branch once the session merges it, and tidies other merged branches on demand with /tidy

noIsolateAgents.title: Agent types without a worktree
noIsolateAgents.description: Comma-separated agent types that never get a worktree, on top of Explore, Plan, claude-code-guide, statusline-setup, scout and reviewer.

readOnlyAgents.title: More read-only agent types (deprecated)
readOnlyAgents.description: Old name for noIsolateAgents, still read. The types listed in either one run without a worktree.

isolateNestedRepos.title: Isolate agents in a repo with nested repos
isolateNestedRepos.description: Give agents worktrees even when the repo's ignored directories hold their own git repos and the repo has no .claude/worktree-setup script. Off by default: such agents run in the main checkout.

portBase.title: Port base
portBase.description: Worktree slot N owns ports portBase + N*10 through portBase + N*10 + 9. Slots start at 1, so portBase..portBase+9 stay free for the main checkout.
